blocks.body:
This sample shows how each block looks on the professionals blog. The text is placeholder copy about the app, not advice.

## Rich text

A rich text block holds Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, [links](https://affiliate.caltrac.ai/how-it-works) and lists.

- A first point
- A second point

### A smaller heading

Headings of level 2 and 3 make the article's table of contents.

blocks.body:
An image and text block puts a picture beside a short text. Here the image is on the right.

The text is Markdown, like a rich text block.

blocks.title: A tip
blocks.body: A callout highlights one short point. Its kind is a tip, a note or a warning.
